ai_analysis.summary: This agreement outlines terms between the Client and AcmeCorp that heavily favor AcmeCorp through severe financial and legal liabilities. It binds the Client to strict short-term payment terms, high compounding interest for delays, and unilateral price increases up to 300%. Furthermore, the Client assumes full liability for AcmeCorp's gross negligence and faces an automatic 10-year renewal unless canceled precisely one year in advance.
obligations: Pay invoices under Net-5 payment terms.
Pay a compounding daily interest rate of 5% on late payments.
Assume 100% of legal liability and indemnify AcmeCorp against all claims, including those caused by AcmeCorp's own gross negligence.
Accept unilateral licensing fee increases of up to 300% without prior written notice.
deadlines: Written notice to prevent automatic 10-year renewal must be provided exactly 365 days prior to contract expiration.
